name: LAN Transfer
launcher.open.detail: Send files, images, and text. Scan the QR code to connect your phone.
launcher.stop.detail: Close the page connection and discard the shared items.
web.scan: Join the same Wi-Fi or local network and scan the QR code.
web.no_network: No local IPv4 address found. Connect this computer to your network and reload.
web.limits: 64 MB per file, 64 KB per message. Shared items are cleared when you stop the session.
web.empty: Items sent from either device appear here.
web.confirm_delete: Remove this item for all connected devices?
web.too_large: This file or message exceeds the size limit.
web.full: The session is full. Remove some shared items and try again.
web.busy: Other uploads are in progress. Try again shortly.
web.disconnected: Connection lost. Check your network or reopen the transfer page from MyTools.
web.failed: The request failed. Please try again.
web.copy_failed: Could not copy. You can select the text manually or download it.
